instruction.name: movgr2fcsr
instruction.description: Move rj into the selected FCSR.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movgr2fcsr $fcsr0, $r4; movgr2fcsr $fcsr1, $r5; movgr2fcsr $fcsr2, $r6; movgr2fcsr $fcsr3, $r7; movgr2fcsr $fcsr0, $r8; movgr2fcsr $fcsr1, $r9; movgr2fcsr $fcsr2, $r10; movgr2fcsr $fcsr3, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'movgr2fcsr $fcsr0, $r4; movgr2fcsr $fcsr1, $r5; movgr2fcsr $fcsr2, $r6; movgr2fcsr $fcsr3, $r7; movgr2fcsr $fcsr0, $r8; movgr2fcsr $fcsr1, $r9; movgr2fcsr $fcsr2, $r10; movgr2fcsr $fcsr3, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 120.00 cycles (15 CPI). Earlier 55.99/120.06 was counter noise, not an unroll effect.

notes: Throughput is nominally 15 CPI. The observed cycles fluctuate by about ±0.1% with system noise; it is not a missing-unroll bias. Round trip with the reverse move is 22.03 cycles; individual latency is not separable.
